papers.title: DiffusionSSD: Achieving Extreme Visual Compression with Dual-stage Diffusion and Cross-level Near-Data Processing
papers.abstract: Growing visual data overwhelms storage on resource-constrained edge devices, making compression essential. Traditional codecs offer inadequate rate-distortion performance, motivating the exploration of diffusion codecs. Diffusion codecs face two limitations: (1) At the algorithm level, diffusion decoders preserve perceptual quality under extreme compression, but require substantial computation. (2) At the architecture level, in NPU-centered devices, neural codecs occupy the NPU, interfering with other AI applications. Meanwhile, the complex codec pipeline incurs long I/O paths, leading to additional overhead and energy cost. To address these issues, we propose DiffusionSSD, a cross-level near-data processing framework for extreme visual data compression on edge devices, using an algorithm-architecture co-design method. Specifically, (1) at algorithm level, we present Dual-stage Diffusion, a lightweight solution tailored for diffusion codecs that employs patchification and single-step diffusion, reducing computation cost while preserving perceptual quality; (2) at architecture level, we introduce a Cross-level Near Data Processing architecture that integrates the proposed computational universal flash storage (cUFS) and LPDDR-PIM, enabling codecs to be entirely offloaded to data side while reducing visual-data movement and avoiding SoC redesign; (3) at system level, combining both the algorithm and the underlying architecture, we propose a Patch-Workload co-aware scheduling scheme to enable more efficient system-level execution. Experiments show that Dual-stage Diffusion maintains comparable perceptual quality while reducing computation cost by up to 92.7%. Compared with NPU+DRAM and near-data-processing design such as SmartSSD, cUFS+PIM improves coding throughput by 2.32 times and 2.91 times on average, respectively.

digest.summaryZh: DiffusionSSD 用双阶段单步扩散压缩减少编解码计算，再把任务卸载到计算型 UFS 与 LPDDR-PIM，并按 patch 和算子能力协同调度。其意义在于减少边缘设备数据搬运及 NPU 争用；报告的架构吞吐收益来自建模仿真，需要与真实芯片实测区分。
digest.motivationZh: 边缘视觉数据增长压迫存储，扩散编解码计算量大，占用共享 NPU 且长 I/O 路径增加搬运成本。单独改进压缩率不能解决执行争用，直接卸载到 UFS 又受带宽与有限计算能力限制。同时降低编解码计算和跨存储层搬运，才能释放端侧 AI 计算资源并控制整体开销。直接关联近数据处理、存储层次和算法架构协同；PIM 应作为跨层数据路径的一部分评估，而非孤立优先。

papers.title: B2G-Agent: An LLM-Based Multi-Agent Tool for End-to-End Building-Grid Interactions
papers.abstract: Buildings are major electricity consumers and can interact with distribution network dispatch through flexible power scheduling. These interactions require distribution network operators (DNOs) and building energy managers (BEMs) to reconcile their operational constraints and perform complex cross-field computations. The lack of cross-domain expertise and unified computational workflows could lead to inefficient or physically infeasible interactions. To address this bottleneck, we develop an end-to-end large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent tool, B2G-Agent, that bridges DNOs and BEMs. The tool deploys three collaborative agents: a Translator for bidirectional cross-domain semantic mapping via hybrid retrieval-augmented generation (RAG); an Actor for automated configuration and execution of joint simulation and optimization through directed acyclic graphs; and a Reviewer for memory-augmented reflective failure diagnosis. This workflow abstracts away cross-field modeling complexities and enables both sides to focus on high-level operational decisions. Comprehensive evaluations across 200 synthesized tasks show that B2G-Agent improves the interaction quality score from 66.71 to 85.57 and increases the task success rate from 38.0% to 69.0% over the baseline while satisfying operational constraints. The open-source tool and interface are available at https://github.com/hkuedl/B2G-Agent.

papers.title: Zero-SM NCCL: A Systematic Guide to Designing and Deploying SM-Free GPU Communication
papers.abstract: GPU communication libraries such as NCCL use Streaming Multiprocessors (SMs) for data movement and synchronization, slowing overlapped computation at a cost that grows with interconnect bandwidth. We present Zero-SM NCCL, which communicates within and across scale-up domains without launching any SM kernel. It synchronizes through CUDA stream memory operations, moves data asynchronously with copy engines within a scale-up domain, and drives network RDMA from a stream-ordered CPU proxy. It supports data-movement collectives such as AllGather and AlltoAll, plus one-sided ncclPutSignal and ncclWaitSignal APIs. On GB200 NVL72 and B200 NVL8 systems, Zero-SM collectives reach up to 1.36x higher AllGather bandwidth than NCCL's legacy SM-based kernels and cut the median slowdown of overlapped GEMMs from 33% to 4%, at a higher latency per operation. In Megatron-LM training, they accelerate FSDP by up to 3.5%, and one-sided puts accelerate pipeline parallelism by up to 15%. Zero-SM communication is not a universal win, however. Through an end-to-end study across models and parallelism strategies, we show that it pays off for large transfers in GPU-bound workloads and for deep pipelines with large bubbles, but loses on small messages and host-bound workloads. We distill these findings into guidelines for enabling zero-SM communication in NCCL and building it into other libraries.

digest.summaryZh: Zero-SM NCCL 将同步交给 CUDA 流内存操作，把域内搬运交给复制引擎、跨域 RDMA 交给 CPU 代理，避免通信占用 SM。端到端训练收益取决于消息规模和主机开销；它适合研究通信计算重叠，也提示专用数据通路仍会争用内存。
digest.motivationZh: NCCL 的数据搬运和同步会占用 SM，拖慢重叠 GEMM，互连变快后通信占用计算资源的代价更突出。仅优化通信内核或调整重叠安排仍保留 SM 争用，需要保留流顺序的独立搬运及同步路径。训练性能由通信和计算共同决定，释放 SM 的收益必须与额外操作延迟和 CPU 发起开销一起衡量。与 GPU 通信引擎、数据通路、训练系统和计算通信资源分离高度相关，适合软硬件协同与核心资源研究。
digest.methodZh: 不启动 SM 内核而完成数据搬运与同步：域内用 copy engine，域外用流顺序 CPU 代理驱动 RDMA。CUDA stream memory operations 保持就绪和完成同步。对称注册缓冲区支持直接远程写入及完成信号。支持数据搬运 collectives 和单边 put/wait 接口，并集成训练通信。研究现有 GPU 复制引擎、NIC 与 CPU 代理的协同；释放 SM 不会消除内存带宽争用，归约类运算尚不支持零 SM 路径。将数据搬运和同步同时移出 SM，并把微基准、重叠干扰与训练步时分层检验。
digest.experimentsZh: 在 GB200 NVL72 与 B200 NVL8 上测通信和 GEMM 重叠，并用 Megatron-LM 的 FSDP、流水线训练检查端到端收益。比较传统 SM NCCL、对称通信路径及 CE 路径；训练分别替换 FSDP AllGather 或流水线 Send/Recv。摘要报告 AllGather 带宽最高 1.36 倍，重叠 GEMM 中位慢化由约 33% 降至 4%；FSDP 最高加速 3.5%，单边 put 的流水线训练最高加速 15%。同时单次操作延迟更高，小消息与主机受限配置可能变慢。不是所有 collective 的通用替代：AllReduce、ReduceScatter 尚不支持零 SM；内核干扰改善不等于同幅度训练加速。测试含尚未发布的扩展功能，复现需核对代码版本与配置。

papers.title: AI Inference-Aware Optimal Power Flow: Converting Token Requirements into Grid Flexibility
papers.abstract: The rapid growth, temporal variability, and geographic concentration of electricity demand from artificial intelligence (AI) inference can aggravate transmission congestion near data centers (DCs). The spatial and temporal flexibility of inference workloads offers an opportunity to alleviate this congestion: requests can be routed across DCs or deferred within users' quality-of-service (QoS) requirements. However, inference routing primarily considers graphics processing unit (GPU) availability, leaving this flexibility underused in grid operation. Using GPU measurements, this paper models inference latency and DC power consumption to quantify the flexibility available under users' time-to-first-token (TTFT) and inter-token latency (ITL) requirements. These models are then incorporated into an AI inference-aware optimal power flow (OPF) that coordinates inference routing and power system operation among DC operators, the transmission system operator, and inference users. By linking user requests, token generation at DCs, and electricity delivery through the transmission network, the formulation schedules inference workloads subject to both users' QoS requirements and transmission constraints.Simulations on the PJM system show that, compared with computing-based routing and with electricity price-based routing, coordinating inference routing with network operation enables growing DC electricity demand deliverable to be met at lower cost.

digest.summaryZh: 论文用 GPU 测量拟合推理延迟与功耗，再将用户 TTFT、ITL 约束映射到跨数据中心路由和电网最优潮流。PJM 仿真显示联合安排算力和网络约束可提高可供电需求并降低成本，关注的是设施级调度，未改变 GPU 内部执行架构。
digest.motivationZh: 推理需求的时空集中会加剧数据中心附近输电拥塞，只按 GPU 空闲或距离路由可能浪费可调度性。单独算力调度或电价路由没有联合考虑用户 token 时延要求和输电网络约束。利用可延期请求和跨中心路由，有机会在服务约束内改善电网可行性与系统成本。与推理服务资源和能源调度有关，属于系统外围研究；对计算核心架构只有间接的负载建模启示。
digest.methodZh: 由 GPU 测量建立 token 延迟和数据中心功耗模型，再把路由、延期、运行副本与发电调度纳入统一 OPF。用 TTFT 和 ITL 限制可达中心与 token 服务能力。协调请求延期、token 路由和数据中心运行副本。同时满足发电、线路和用户服务约束。属于跨数据中心与电网优化；硬件测量用于服务曲线拟合，没有提出新 GPU/NPU 或片内数据流。把用户 token 服务要求显式连接到输电网络，联合优化原本分开的推理与供电安排。
digest.experimentsZh: 正文在 PJM 网络上仿真，数据中心服务曲线参考 Llama-3.1-405B 在八张 H100 上的测量拟合，并设置用户时延和延期约束。比较按算力空闲和往返延迟路由，以及按事前节点电价路由。摘要定性报告联合优化相较两类基线能以较低成本满足增长需求；正文案例显示高推理负荷下两类基线有不可行时段，而联合 OPF 在该案例保持可行。本摘要不推断通用节能比例。证据是测量拟合与电网仿真，效果依赖需求、网络、价格及允许延期；不能视为在线服务部署或芯片能效改善。

papers.abstract: The European Space Agency's Euclid mission has issued its first major data release(Data Release 1, DR1), providing a transformative view of the extragalactic sky through deep photometry and near-infrared slitless spectroscopy. This paper presents the Euclid DR1 spectroscopic data set and details the evolution of the spectroscopic processing function (SPE PF) pipeline, which is responsible for the automated analysis of 1-dimensional spectra acquired by the Near-Infrared Spectro-Photometer (NISP). The SPE PF pipeline workflow comprises spectroscopic classification, redshift determination, and the systematic measurement of spectral features. Emission line fluxes are derived using two independent methodologies: direct integration (DI) and Gaussian fitting (GF). For sources exhibiting broad H$α$ profiles (velocity dispersion larger than $1500$ km s$^{-1}$), a dedicated `QSO mode' is implemented to robustly deconvolve nuclear and host galaxy components. The data set was validated by cross-matching Euclid results with external spectroscopic catalogues, specifically Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI) DR1, and through an extensive visual inspection campaign of approximately 4000 sources within the Euclid Deep Field North (EDF-N). For high-quality samples selected in the EDF-N, we find a 98.5\% agreement between Euclid and DESI spectroscopic redshifts. This success rate increases to 98.9\% when incorporating pipeline probability and reliability estimators. (abridged)

digest.summaryZh: Euclid DR1 论文介绍近红外一维光谱的分类、红移和谱线测量流程，用外部 DESI 数据及人工检查验证质量。它是天文数据处理研究，虽然队列标记为硬件主线，但内容没有 AI 处理器或 LLM 加速贡献，建议归档而非精读。
digest.motivationZh: 大规模巡天需要可靠自动处理光谱，区分源类别并测定红移和谱线通量，避免错误影响后续科学分析。广谱线与核区和宿主混合等情况需要专用处理，自动红移质量还需外部样本和人工证据验证。数据发布的科学用途依赖可解释的质量标记和稳定测量，而非仅增加已处理光谱数量。与用户的芯片、LLM 量化、内存层次和训练推理系统缺少直接联系，队列硬件标签不符合本文实际内容。
digest.methodZh: 更新 Euclid SPE PF 自动光谱分析流程，组合分类、红移估计及双方法谱线测量并外部验证。对 NISP 一维光谱进行光谱分类、红移确定和谱特征测量。用直接积分与高斯拟合独立估计发射线通量。对宽 Hα 源使用 QSO 模式分离核与宿主成分。属于天文分析流程，未提出 AI 加速器硬件或 LLM 执行优化，不能把光谱处理吞吐推断为芯片贡献。针对 DR1 数据细化自动光谱处理和质量验证，主要贡献是天文数据产品与分析可靠性。
digest.experimentsZh: 将 Euclid 结果与 DESI DR1 光谱目录交叉匹配，并人工检查 EDF-N 约 4000 个源。以外部 DESI 光谱红移和人工检查为参照；DI 与 GF 是两种测量方法而非硬件基线。完整摘要报告 EDF-N 高质量选样与 DESI 红移一致率为 98.5%，结合管线概率和可靠性估计后为 98.9%。这是选定样本的一致性，不能当成全部源无条件准确率。队列英文摘要注明 abridged；这里仅据完整保留的该摘要及公开 HTML 摘要分析。未覆盖所有天区与选择函数，也没有处理器性能或能效证据。

papers.title: LABEL: Literature Asymmetry between Efficacy and Limits in Drug Knowledge and Language Models
papers.abstract: Every medication comes with two types of medical facts: indications, which describe what conditions the drug treats (benefits), and contraindications, which describe who must avoid it to prevent serious harm (safety limits). Although contraindications are critical for patient safety and FDA regulations require listing them as rigorously as indications, we find that contraindications are far less documented than indications in general prose. In this paper, we measure how often these texts contain both facts across 574 drugs from PrimeKG by comparing a drug's indications against its own contraindications. Across Wikipedia articles and PubMed abstracts, we find that reference prose names a drug's benefits about twice as often as its safety limits (within-drug odds ratio 2.19). We call this documentation gap LABEL (Literature Asymmetry between Efficacy and Limits). Language models mirror this gap. As we scale Qwen2.5 from 0.5B to 14B, accuracy on indications rises by 18.3 points, whereas accuracy on contraindications remains flat near random guessing. However, when we provide models with a retrieved passage that states the answer, they use safety facts just as effectively as benefits. Furthermore, routing safety questions to official FDA labels boosts accuracy by 15.8 points whenever the label states the fact. Overall, our findings show that models fail on medication safety not because they cannot reason about risk, but because free-text corpora lack safety facts. Clinical AI systems should therefore route medication-safety questions to official regulatory labels and structured databases rather than relying on general public records. Code and data are available at https://github.com/SMRayeed/LABEL.

papers.title: A Unified Control Framework, Mathematical Model, and Five-layer Closed-loop Case Study for Embodied Intelligence Control Systems
papers.abstract: Embodied intelligence holds that an agent develops cognition and behavior through real-time body-environment interaction, so its control system must tightly couple perception, decision making, learning, optimization, constraints, and physical execution. This report asks whether a unified framework exists, how its mathematical models unify, and how the framework is realized computably. Four conclusions emerge. (1) No single framework is accepted, but the field converges on a common skeleton: from operational-space and whole-body control to MPC, reinforcement learning, active inference, and diffusion/flow policies, all reduce to constrained sequential decision making on the configuration manifold. (2) Two languages describe it-deterministic optimal control (Euler-Lagrange plus constrained OCP, reduced in real time to a QP) and probabilistic inference (MDP/POMDP plus free-energy minimization)-rigorously bridged by control as inference and KL/path-integral control. (3) Engineering unification is already achieved by constrained optimization; the new frontier is cross-morphology, cross-task shared representation. (4) The hardest gap is provable stability and safety, the entry point for spectral, geometric, differentiable-optimization, and safe-learning methods. A single-link manipulator then runs through all five layers: L4 parses the instruction into a reference, L3 identifies a Koopman lifted linear world model, L2 solves a receding constrained QP, L1 adds torque saturation and a CBF, and L0 is the true nonlinear plant. Closed-loop tracking RMSE is 0.0218 rad with all constraints satisfied and a world-model error near 5 x 10^-6 rad, reported with curves and a 3D animation.

papers.title: Generalization Testing of Grid Foundation Models for Power Flow and Optimal Power Flow
papers.abstract: There is growing interest in foundation models (FMs) for power grids, particularly for power flow and optimal power flow. Their usefulness depends on generalization accuracy, which existing works test on their own benchmarks. We propose a three-axis framework to test their generalization limits: changed admittance matrices of training grids, load levels, and unseen grids. We test GENCO, LUMINA and GridSFM against the DC baseline, alongside their reported limitations, and discuss theoretical reasons for their failures. Experiments reveal that adding a line degrades all FMs more than removing one, and longer lines eventually make LUMINA and fine-tuned GENCO worse than DC. All three degrade beyond their training load range, where the loading-voltage curve steepens. On unseen grids, LUMINA degrades sharply even inside its training range, and GridSFM fails on the grid farthest from it. Thus, beyond training conditions, FMs behave more like meta-models requiring test-time fine-tuning data and compute.

digest.summaryZh: 论文以导纳矩阵、负载区间和未见电网三条轴测试电网基础模型，发现新增线路、超训练负荷及跨网络预测可能失效。它提示平均误差会掩盖物理约束违例，但对象是电网代理模型，与 LLM 处理器设计缺乏直接联系。
digest.motivationZh: 电网基础模型需在拓扑、负载和未见网络上保持可用，仅依赖各自训练基准的平均误差难揭示失效。现有测试没有统一覆盖新增线路、极端负载与跨网络分布偏移，也可能忽视物理约束违例。预测器若不报告不确定性而静默出错，模型的实际用途需通过超出训练条件的压力测试评估。提供分布外评估的方法论参考，但主体是电力潮流模型，未研究 LLM 量化、加速器或存储系统。
digest.methodZh: 沿改变导纳矩阵、超训练负载和未见电网三个方向系统扰动，比较模型预测与 DC 近似及物理指标。在训练网络上增删或延长线路改变导纳矩阵。将负载提高到训练范围外观察误差。在未见网络上检验零样本及微调后的行为。属于领域基础模型评估，没有提出新硬件；测试时微调所需数据和计算只是部署成本讨论。把分布偏移拆成可解释的三轴，并强调成本误差与物理约束违例可能给出不同判断。
digest.experimentsZh: 测试 GENCO、LUMINA、GridSFM，正文包含训练网络的拓扑变更及跨网络测试，区分零样本和微调模式。使用 DC 潮流或 DC 最优潮流近似作为对照，并依模型任务比较相应输出。摘要指出新增线路通常比删线更易导致退化；线路足够长时 LUMINA 和微调 GENCO 可劣于 DC，三者在训练负荷范围外均退化；未见网络上也出现明显失效。结论针对被测模型与所选电网，不等同于所有基础模型都无法泛化。预测模式的失败不代表结合精确求解器的初始化方案必然失效，也没有硬件效率结果。
